text:
Sam: Heads-up — scheduled cross-service deployment tonight in the 10pm PT change window. Main pieces: API v4.12, Runtime v2.3.1, Router v2.3.1, Console mapping update. Please confirm pins and any gotchas ASAP.

Rachel: Runtime team: we validated 2.3.1 on staging for our seq len distribution but noticed a kernel flag needed for longer contexts (KV_PREFETCH=true).

Mike: Router: can pin v2.3.1 but it requires the new route hashing toggle enabled (route_hash_v2). Will toggle in canary only.

Tina: Console: mapping change to surface model variant names — small schema bump, no infra change. We'll coordinate DB migration at 10:05pm.

Sam: Plan: canary 5% for first 10m, then 50% next 10m, then full. Rollback if 95th latency increase > 100ms or 5xx > 1%. Anyone object?

Nina: Product good with canary plan and release notes. I'll add the user-facing blurb and callouts for Dedicated customers.

Rachel: Confirmed pin command for runtime: ```pin-service --service=runtime --version=2.3.1 --flag KV_PREFETCH=true``` Add me for rollback owner.

Mike: Router pin command: ```pin-service --service=router --version=2.3.1 --toggle route_hash_v2:on``` I'll monitor 502/latency; router team will own rollback if 5xx spikes.

Sam: Great. I'll open the orchestration and request interlock. Deploy window is 2151237600-2151241200 UTC (10pm-11pm PT). Oncall?

Oncall-Bot: Change window confirmed. Paging policy active. Pager threshold: errors >= 5% sustained over 1m.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Orchestration created: deploy-id=rdw-deploy-20260315-10p. Stages: preflight -> canary -> ramp -> cutover. Logs stream: https://deploy.redwood/rdw-deploy-20260315-10p

Sam: Execute preflight now (health checks + smoke). If preflight fails we abort.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Preflight: OK. Health checks passed for API/runtime/router/console (smoke). Proceed to canary? (need ack)

Rachel: ack runtime canary go :thumbsup:

Mike: router ack. enabling route_hash_v2 on canary hosts.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Canary start: 5% traffic -> router v2.3.1, runtime v2.3.1, api v4.12. Canary window open.

Mike: Observing initial 502s bump on canary edge (3x baseline) — digging in. :eyes:

Rachel: Runtime telemetry shows KV cache evictions spike coincident with router 502s. Could be increased request fanout pattern.

Mike: Rolling router back on canary to v2.2.9 to isolate. Executing: ```rollback-service --service=router --to-version=2.2.9 --deploy-id=rdw-deploy-20260315-10p```

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Router rollback executed on canary. Router canary traffic back to baseline.

Rachel: After router rollback, runtime evictions normalized. Looks like route_hash_v2 exposed an edge case with certain request headers. We'll open a debug ticket.

Sam: Thanks. We'll block router v2.3.1 for full rollout until fix; continue with API/runtime/console ramp (no router new). Update pins accordingly: runtime pinned, router unpinned for full.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Update: router pin canceled for full rollout. Runtime and API continue ramping to 50% per plan.

Nina: Updating release notes and customer comms: note that router feature toggle remains behind flag, customers on Dedicated unaffected.

Sam: Post-deploy follow-ups: Rachel/Mike please add root cause + mitigation to the deploy ticket. I'll mark rollback decision and state machine in release notes. We'll schedule a follow-up patch deploy for router once fix merges.

Tina: Console migration completed at 10:05pm with no errors.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: Deploy completed to 100% (router stayed on previous stable). deploy-id=rdw-deploy-20260315-10p status=partial-success.

Sam: Good job team. Short postmortem and a quick sync tomorrow AM to triage router toggle. :thumbsup:
